title: Combining experiments and simulations to examine the temperature-dependent behaviour of a disordered protein
one_liner_zh: 该文结合MD模拟与实验数据研究无序蛋白Histatin 5的温度依赖构象行为，虽聚焦单蛋白构象而非PPI，但其无序蛋白构象系综建模与实验整合方法对本课题的机制建模有可迁移启发。
abstract: Intrinsically disordered proteins are a class of proteins that lack stable folded conformations and instead adopt a range of conformations that determine their biochemical functions. The temperature-dependent behaviour of such disordered proteins is complex and can vary depending on the specific protein and environment. Here, we have used molecular dynamics simulations and previously published experimental data to investigate the temperature-dependent behaviour of Histatin 5, a 24-residue-long polypeptide. We examined the hypothesis that Histatin 5 undergoes a loss of polyproline II structure with increasing temperature, leading to more compact conformations. We found that the conformational ensembles generated by the simulations generally agree with small-angle X-ray scattering data for Histatin 5, but show some discrepancies with the hydrodynamic radius as probed by pulsed-field gradient nuclear magnetic resonance spectroscopy, and with the secondary structure information derived from circular dichroism. We attempted to reconcile these differences by reweighting the conformational ensembles against the scattering and NMR data. By doing so, we were in part able to capture the temperature-dependent behaviour of Histatin 5 and to link the observed decrease in hydrodynamic radius with increasing temperature to a loss of polyproline II structure. We were, however, unable to achieve agreement with both the scattering and NMR data within experimental errors. We discuss different possibilities for this outcome including inaccuracies in the force field, differences in conditions of the NMR and scattering experiments, and issues related to the calculation of the hydrodynamic radius from conformational ensembles. Our study highlights the importance of integrating multiple types of experimental data when modelling conformational ensembles of disordered proteins and how environmental factors such as the temperature influence them.
abstract_zh: 固有无序蛋白是一类缺乏稳定折叠构象的蛋白质，它们转而采用一系列决定其生化功能的构象。这类无序蛋白的温度依赖性行为复杂，且可能因具体蛋白质和环境而异。在本研究中，我们利用分子动力学模拟及先前发表的实验数据，探讨了Histatin 5（一种由24个残基组成的多肽）的温度依赖性行为。我们检验了以下假设：随着温度升高，Histatin 5会失去聚脯氨酸II型结构，从而导致更紧凑的构象。我们发现，模拟生成的构象集合总体上与Histatin 5的小角X射线散射数据相符，但与脉冲场梯度核磁共振波谱探测的水动力学半径以及圆二色谱得出的二级结构信息存在一定差异。我们尝试通过根据散射和核磁共振数据对构象集合进行重新加权来调和这些差异。通过这一方法，我们部分捕捉到了Histatin 5的温度依赖性行为，并将观察到的水动力学半径随温度升高而减小与聚脯氨酸II型结构的丧失联系起来。然而，我们未能使散射和核磁共振数据在实验误差范围内达成一致。我们讨论了导致这一结果的各种可能性，包括力场的不准确性、核磁共振与散射实验条件的差异，以及从构象集合计算水动力学半径的相关问题。我们的研究强调了在建模无序蛋白构象集合及其受温度等环境因素影响时，整合多种类型实验数据的重要性。
